title: Outdated Hotkey / BepInEx Assumption
fix: x4 AiLive is a native X4 extension! You do NOT need BepInEx or Shift+C. Simply walk up to any NPC in-game and select 'Speak with AI' from the dialogue menu.

title: Player2 AI Companion Connection Refused
fix: Ensure the free Player2 AI Companion app is running on your machine (https://player2.game). x4 AiLive communicates locally over http://127.0.0.1:4315.

title: X4 Forge Extension Update Not Applied
fix: After updating X4 Forge Studio in VS Code / Open VSX, press Ctrl+Shift+P (or Cmd+Shift+P) and run 'Developer: Reload Window' to ensure the latest extension backend engine loads cleanly.

title: DJFHE HTTP Transport Missing Warning
fix: x4 AiLive is serverless (ADR-009) and includes built-in HTTP transport (aic_http.lua). Ensure the extension folder in X4 Foundations/extensions/ is named exactly x4_ai_influence.
